- "printed_value": the value exactly as it is printed on the page, including any extra parts printed with it (e.g. a time printed after a date, a currency symbol). Empty string if you cannot see it.
- "is_printed_pair": true if the field appears on the page as a label followed by its value.

Do not invent labels. Transcribe exactly as printed.
